description: This Java class, ConceptDatatypeEditor, extends a generic property editor to handle the serialization and deserialization of ConceptDatatype objects within the OpenMRS framework, including retrieval by ID and UUID.

classes.name: ConceptDatatypeEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for converting ConceptDatatype objects to and from their string representations, supporting ID and UUID based retrieval.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptDatatype object by its integer ID using the ConceptService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptDatatype object by its UUID string using the ConceptService.
